title: Attractive but lightweight
text: Attractive but lightweight. This is a pretty table runner. It does have a "modern farmhouse" feel in that there is a lot of texture to the weave, the colors are soft and warm and the runner is a chevron pattern. The runner is 72 inches long and 15 inches wide. The edges are also tasseled. I didnt give it 5 stars because it is so lightweight. It slides all around constantly and has to be smoothed out all.the.time.  As a result, it's barely worth it to use. I have kids who make this runner all bunched up simply by looking at it.
